content:
**One Star – Save Your Money and Your Back**

I purchased this foam mattress hoping for the cloud-like comfort the listing promised, but what I received was closer to sleeping on a stale slab of bread. Within the first week, a noticeable sag formed right in the middle, and I weigh well under the supposed weight limit advertised on the product page. The chemical smell when I unboxed it was overpowering, and even after airing it out for nearly two weeks, the odor lingered in my bedroom. It also sleeps incredibly hot, to the point where I wake up sweating in the middle of the night regardless of the room temperature. The edges collapse the moment you sit on them, so getting in and out of bed feels unstable and cheap. Customer service was no help either, insisting I needed to "break it in" for 30 more days before they would even consider a return. By the time their arbitrary trial period ended, I was stuck with a mattress that had already given me weeks of back and neck pain. Do yourself a favor and spend a little more on a reputable brand, because this one is not worth the headache or the chiropractor bills.
